methods.weighting: one measurement per agreeing original activity and characteristic; all raw columns checked except ResultIdentifier and its limit URL
methods.below_limit: nonnegative [0, original Lower Quantitation Limit), no substitution
methods.same_day: literal date equality, clock-zone agreement, method/unit/fraction/speciation/depth/status support equality; project and collection-time differences retained
methods.summaries: one sampled activity weight; analytical supports separated; endpoint means and medians
methods.nitrogen: same-activity unfiltered as-N Kjeldahl nitrogen plus nitrate/nitrite
methods.scope: sampled observations; no annual time weighting, load conversion or intervention attribution
